history.name: Re-filing is not a change to the product
history.description: Moving a feature to a different area, into a sub-section, or up and down the size scale changes where the entry lives, not what the product does — so it applies to the feature as a whole and doesn't ask for a change note or announce itself to the client as something that moved.
history.dev_notes: In cmdUpdate, category/subcategory/size are set on the Feature rather than on the version's history entry.
